summary.list_empty: No project matches{{query}}. Add one with specrails_projects(add, path).
summary.selected: {{name}} is now this session's default project.
summary.cleared: This session has no default project now.
summary.added: {{name}} registered as {{slug}}; its workspace assembles in the background. Check specrails_projects(install_status).
summary.provisioning: Setup started for {{name}} ({{providers}}). Call specrails_wait(until, refs) or install_status.
summary.assembling: Workspace assembly retried for {{name}}. Check install_status.
summary.install_idle: Setup of {{name}} is not running; {{done}} of {{total}} checkpoints done.
summary.repository_removed: Repository {{repository}} removed from {{name}}; its files stay on disk.
summary.unregistered: {{name}} was unregistered; its files stay on disk.
summary.sample_created: Sample project {{name}} is ready with {{count}} specs.
summary.sample_reused: The sample project {{name}} already exists; reused it.
summary.prerequisites_ok: Every required tool is installed; providers: {{providers}}.
effect.unregister: Unregisters {{name}} ({{path}}) and stops its running work. Its files stay on disk.
effect.repository_remove: Removes repository {{repository}} ({{path}}) from {{name}}. Its files stay on disk.
effect.provision: Installs the Specrails workspace (quick, offline) for {{providers}} in {{name}}.
error.no_destination: clone needs a destination: path (or options.destination), an absolute new folder.
error.no_sample: There is no sample project to remove.
error.repository_update_empty: repository_update needs at least one of path, name, options.integrationBranch, options.workspacePaths.
summary.clone_started: Cloning into {{path}} in the background ({{ref}}); it registers the project when done. Follow it with specrails_wait(until, refs:["{{ref}}"]).
summary.clone_running: Still cloning into {{path}}{{progress}}. Follow it with specrails_wait(until, refs:["{{ref}}"]).
error.clone_unknown: No clone {{ref}} is known: it never started on this computer or its record expired.
